text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, having completed her first three years and steadily preparing for the upcoming overseas expedition—

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Uraaaagh!!
—Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A sharp roar, and a rising cloud of dust. Suddenly, cheers erupted from a corner of the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Ramonu and Sirius running in tandem?!
Wow, I'm so glad I'm out on the track right now~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible, you can feel
the heat from the turf all the way over here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two round the final corner.
Sirius Symboli pulls up alongside
the front-running Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a faint smile, Mejiro Ramonu accelerated even further.
—And Sirius Symboli bared her fangs, refusing to let her get away.

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaahhhhhh!!
Haaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The air trembles from the sheer intensity.
Cloaked in a numbing heat, the two of them—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They plunged across the finish line in a tangled scramble.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
………………*gasp*!
That was incredible! I completely forgot to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Man, now that was a sight to behold!
So that's "Mejiro Ramonu" and "Sirius Symboli"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching the two of them race with rapt attention was Sakura Laurel, a bright and earnest Umamusume from the Victory Club, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming all the way from America to chase big dreams,
she's the daring Umamusume, Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "If I recall correctly, Sirius is going on an overseas expedition soon, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: A two-year timeframe alone is unprecedented domestically, and on top of that, the final goal race is—

text_block_list.name: Laurel & Tap
text_block_list.text: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Right in the middle of charging ahead with a massive dream at your back, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The first Japanese Umamusume to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...
Aaargh, I can't even fathom how much money that would bring in!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, the attention from sponsors
might be pretty huge. Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but even if not...
...The 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe', huh."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
As I thought, there are dreams across the sea, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the turf, the eyes of those two—
reflected Sirius Symboli shining brilliantly
under the blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Laurel and Tap?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You don't strike me as the type to happily
walk down a path made by others, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She never said she wanted to
"become like Sirius Symboli."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, going abroad had become a very
realistic option for their future.
choice_data_list: You're not just a guide, you're a pioneer.
You're not a guide — you're a pioneer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gave concrete form to "possibility."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This might end up affecting far more Umamusume in the future than I ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, you always exaggerate everything,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
First off, it hasn't even started yet.
If I mess up, it's straight back to 'it's too difficult after all.'
choice_data_list: Do we have plans like that?
Do we have plans like that?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking big now.
Has that collar finally started suiting you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hell no. What else did you expect?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A carefully aimed cue
strikes the ball with a light tap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Balls are knocked away one after another,
and the last one left rolling is—the promised 9-ball.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no failure in challenging the world.
Having delivered results in every single race, she is certain to claim victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because that is who "Sirius Symboli" is.
